QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_3

question.text: When were the Indian Social Stock Exchange segments (NSE-SSE and BSE-SSE) officially launched?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** India launched the NSE-SSE and BSE-SSE segments in September 2022, following SEBI notification of the SSE framework amendments to the ICDR Regulations 2018 in July 2022 and the notification of ZCZP as a 'security' under the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 w.e.f. 15 July 2022. **The Trap:** July 2021 predates the regulatory framework. April 2020 confuses with COVID-era relief dates. January 2023 is after the launch and mistakes the first issuance (Jan 2023 — UNNATI foundation ZCZP) for the segment launch. **Cross-Exam Context:** In III-A / III-C (Compliance) the launch timeline affects the applicability calendar for LODR Chapter IXA disclosures. In XIX-A/B/C/D/E (AIF) the same September 2022 is the reference point for Social Impact Fund (Cat I AIF sub-category) registration. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Assessors empanelling with ICAI in 2024-25 may encounter 'legacy' ZCZP listings dating Jan-Mar 2023 — always check the Scheme Information Document / Fund Raising Document date to align the assessment period correctly with the listing event.
